summary: Iteration 3 testing of Ringkasan Prodi, Password Reset (send-reset + /reset-password), and Audit Log. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iter3_features.py with 16 pytest cases — all 16 passed (dashboard scope for admin/kaprodi/dosen, RBAC on send-reset, reset-info valid/invalid, short password rejection, reset success + login, token reuse rejection, audit RBAC + filter + grade mutation records). Frontend: verified prodi-summary-card renders for kaprodi (Teknik Informatika + Fakultas Sains dan Teknologi) and dosen; NOT rendered for admin. Admin can see nav-audit and /audit page (audit-table + audit-entity-filter working, filter=Pengguna returns 7 rows). Reset flow: admin -> reset-user-<id> -> modal with reset-link-value + copy-reset-link-button shown for fake-domain emails. Public /reset-password?token=bogus shows reset-invalid-message. E2E: created test user via API -> admin UI clicked reset -> got link -> opened /reset-password -> submitted new pw -> redirected to /login -> logged in with new password successfully (HTTP 200) -> cleaned up test user.

issues: Pie chart 'Distribusi Predikat' legend shows 'Predikat undefined' entries when grade_distribution has zero-count items. Non-blocking; consider filtering zero-count items or fixing the Legend formatter to fall back to entry.value for grade name.

backend_test_results.TestDashboardScope: 3/3 pass — admin scope has role only; kaprodi & dosen have prodi_name=Teknik Informatika + fakultas_name containing 'Sains'
backend_test_results.TestPasswordReset: 8/8 pass — dosen/kaprodi 403; admin returns reset_link+expires_at; reset-info valid returns email; bogus token -> 400; short pw -> 400; success + relogin with new pw; token reuse -> 400
backend_test_results.TestAuditLog: 5/5 pass — dosen/kaprodi 403; admin lists w/ actor_email+action+entity+timestamp; entity=pengguna filter works; grade create/delete produce buat & hapus entries on entity=nilai

frontend_test_results.prodi_summary_card_kaprodi: PASS (Teknik Informatika + Fakultas Sains dan Teknologi)
frontend_test_results.reset_password_invalid_token: PASS (reset-invalid-message: 'Tautan tidak valid atau sudah digunakan')
frontend_test_results.reset_password_e2e: PASS (create user -> admin sends reset -> open link -> new pw -> redirect /login -> login 200)
frontend_test_results.audit_page: PASS (audit-table renders; audit-entity-filter Pengguna returns 7 rows; kirim_reset, reset_sandi, buat, hapus actions all visible)

action_items: Cosmetic: Dashboard pie chart legend shows 'Predikat undefined' for zero-count grade buckets — filter grade_distribution to count>0 for legend, or use entry.payload?.grade fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: send_reset endpoint returns reset_link unconditionally (even when email is delivered). This is documented as by-design for admin fallback; acceptable but consider hiding the link when email_sent=true to reduce accidental exposure.
log_audit uses role='-' when reset_sandi is performed by anonymous flow — makes filter/UX weaker. Consider setting actor_role='public' or keeping the target user's role for clarity.
reset_info returns generic 400 for both expired and used/invalid tokens; the /auth/reset-info endpoint distinguishes messages internally but frontend only reads detail. This is fine.
AuditLog page fetches on every entity change with no pagination beyond backend limit=200; adequate for now.
Password reset token TTL is 2 hours — reasonable; ensure old resets are periodically pruned (currently they linger in db.password_resets forever).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for critical iter3 flows (prodi summary card, reset modal, /reset-password, E2E reset, audit page + filter)

Use page.expect_response for '/auth/login' rather than page.wait_for_url('**/dashboard**'). Reset link URL example: {FRONTEND_URL}/reset-password?token=<urlsafe>. Public endpoints (no auth): GET /api/auth/reset-info?token=, POST /api/auth/reset-password. Audit entries persist across tests — filter by entity to narrow.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only minor cosmetic legend issue in Dashboard pie chart when there is no grade data.
